summary: Add FILES TO CHECK BEFORE WRITING section to formatForLLM output
context: Benchmark showed full-twining agents call assemble but don't read the affected files before writing. shared-markdown agents read 3-5 files because COORDINATION.md tells them which to check. Full-twining agents read 0-2.
rationale: Explicit read directives as a checklist (Read src/events/bus.ts) push agents to open files before writing, improving pattern consistency and context recovery scores.
